scope.slide_7: Split counts, operational-feature count, repeated-CV design and results, proxy audit, seed and ordinal are bound to frozen sources.
scope.derivation_rule: Observed values are independently sourced, never copied from displayed deck text. Extracted observed claims are not design constants. CSV records and bibliographic strings were independently transformed with the explicit Python311 interpreter before serialization.

deck_order.transformation: Read-only python-pptx enumeration; assumed presentation-design ordinal labels.

label_window.transformation: Parse documented label endpoints as assumed design-label constants, not observed counts.

frozen_evaluation.source_locator: metric_row line 320; bootstrap loop line 385; intervals quantiles line 393
frozen_evaluation.transformation: Read-only ast.parse and ast.literal_eval of numeric configuration literals; confidence_level = upper_quantile - lower_quantile. The analysis code was not imported or executed.
frozen_evaluation.caveat: Frozen evaluation-design settings only; metrics and interval endpoints are bound directly to frozen output JSON. No scoring, bootstrap rerun or fitting was performed.

enhancement_headroom.transformation: Parse the explicitly documented corrected interval confidence percentage from the frozen actual non-test run specification; divide by 100. No interval recomputation.

deployment_intervals.source_locator: AST Call nodes at line 180: vals.quantile(.025), vals.quantile(.975)
deployment_intervals.transformation: Read-only ast.parse and ast.literal_eval of the frozen interval probability literals; confidence_level = upper_quantile - lower_quantile. No importing or executing scientific code.

pilot_decision_gates.transformation: Parse numeric confidence and zero thresholds from the independently frozen decision-gate definitions; familywise_alpha_bound = len(harm_looks) * one_sided_alpha_per_harm_look (Bonferroni union bound). No contact-cost aliases or treatment-outcome computation.

data_partitions.source_locator: All four named partition records: partition, customers and sample_churn_rate fields.
data_partitions.transformation: csv.DictReader; customers cast to int and sample_churn_rate cast to float; index by partition. No predictions or labels scored.
